{{Quote|I'm known as Irenez. I'm currently involved in fighting Black Sun. If you're interested in helping Corellia fight back against the criminals that try to plunder her I could certainly use your help. Interested?|Irenez|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Irenez''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Biography==
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Irenez and [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] were active on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where Irenez was involved in fighting the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. She hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to help her capture the Black Sun [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]] [[Tessa Wylden]], who would reveal valuable information about the organization. Through Wylden, Irenez learned that the Black Sun had hired an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] called [[Skazz]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the head of the [[Corellian Security Force]] and ordered the spacer to intercept the assassin and eliminate him. Further information from Wylden revealed that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had been selling weapons to the Black Sun. Irenez enlisted the spacer's help a third time to attack and kill a group of Black Sun members and disrupt the weapons deal.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Irenez was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Irenez [[Irenez (Human)|shares her name]] with a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender|female]] who first appeared in ''[[Dark Force Rising]]''.<ref name="DFRSB">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref> Like the Twi'lek version,<ref name="AED" /> the Human Irenez served under Garm Bel Iblis.<ref name="DFRSB" /> Irenez and her associated questline were eventually removed from the game by the developers.<ref name="AED" />
